findings.evidence: The LENGTH-substitution guard is gated by `ctx.IsConstantPropagateCheck()` in `pkg/expression/util.go:471-492`; `expression.PropagateConstant` enables the flag via `exprctx.WithConstantPropagateCheck(ctx)` in `pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go:361-363`, but outer-join constant propagation does not: `PropConstOverOuterJoin` assigns `solver.ctx = ctx` without wrapping in `pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go:685-694`, and then substitutes join conditions via `ColumnSubstitute(s.ctx, ...)` in `pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go:504-526`; planner outer-join ppd calls this with the unwrapped session context in `pkg/planner/core/rule_predicate_push_down.go:578`, and `SessionExprContext.IsConstantPropagateCheck()` returns false in `pkg/expression/contextsession/sessionctx.go:117-120`. Checked later history: upstream/master still has the same pattern (`upstream/master:pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go:987-999` sets `solver.ctx = ctx`; `upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go:1976-1981` passes `GetExprCtx()`), so this is not later-fixed.
findings.fix: Wrap the context passed into outer-join constant propagation with the same check wrapper used by `PropagateConstant`, e.g. set `solver.ctx = exprctx.WithConstantPropagateCheck(ctx)` inside `PropConstOverOuterJoin` (and any analogous outer-join/anti join constant-prop entry points), so `ColumnSubstituteImpl` can reliably block unsafe `LENGTH(col)` substitution under PAD SPACE collations.
findings.impact: Potential wrong results for outer join / anti-semi join queries when ON/join conditions contain both `outerCol = 'const'` and `length(outerCol) ...` under PAD SPACE collations (e.g. `utf8_bin`/`utf8mb4_bin`): `outerCol='a'` does not imply the stored value has no trailing spaces, so substituting into `length(outerCol)` can incorrectly relax join conditions and change match/null-extension behavior.
findings.verify: Add a planner casetest covering outer joins, e.g. create `t(name varchar(10) collate utf8mb4_bin)` with rows `('a')` and `('a ')`, then run a LEFT JOIN with ON clause `t.name='a' AND length(t.name)=1 AND t.name=s.name` and assert the planner does not rewrite away the `length(t.name)=1` predicate (and that query results do not include matches for `t.name='a '` that should be filtered by length).
findings.what: Outer-join constant propagation (`PropConstOverOuterJoin`) bypasses the new constant-propagation safety flag, so the PR’s fix to prevent substituting constants into `length(col)` under PAD SPACE collations can still be bypassed in join-condition propagation, reintroducing the same class of incorrect simplification (wrong SQL semantics) for outer-join predicate propagation.

subject: planner: The length function could not be substitute when collation of mapped column is utfxxx_bin (#54179)
summary: Adds a new `IsConstantPropagateCheck` context flag and a guarded special-case in `ColumnSubstituteImpl` to prevent unsafe constant propagation into `length(col)` for `utf8_bin`/`utf8mb4_bin`, plus planner casetest coverage for predicate pushdown. However, the outer-join constant-propagation entry point does not enable the flag, so the unsafe substitution can still happen when propagating constants across outer-join ON conditions.
